review:
A 5x5 gold mine where wild bombs are the main event. Three free spins symbols unlock just six free spins – deliberately small.

The bonus is about collecting gold: every piece you collect upgrades the bombs, adds more spins and makes them explode into bigger patterns of wilds. The longer it lasts, the more of the grid gets covered. A modest 2,015x cap keeps it less extreme than many modern games. 96.46% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
